Subject: Sponsorship addendum: alternate session format & visibility ask

Hi Evelyn,

Great to have Redwood confirmed as a Platinum sponsor. A couple of quick items popped up from programming this morning that I wanted to surface before we finalize the sponsor agreement:

1) Session format — the program team is proposing our 25-minute keynote be converted to a "fireside forum" (15-min moderated discussion + 10-min audience Q&A). They think this helps flow between tracks but it reduces the time for a demo. Can Redwood confirm whether a moderated format is acceptable, or if we need the full prepared talk?

2) Additional visibility — the marketing team requested we add a small onstage roller-banner (logo + booth number) to the keynote backdrop and a co-branded pre-roll slide before our session. This wasn't in the original Platinum benefits. We can add a short addendum to the contract to capture those placement items, and we can do it at no extra cost if agreed by Friday.

I've attached a draft addendum (CF-Summit_Sponsor_Addendum_v3.pdf) with the proposed language. If you prefer, Lily (cc'd) can issue a version with your legal language included.

Can you confirm whether the fireside format works and whether we'll accept the banner / pre-roll additions? If you accept, we'll attach the addendum to the DocuSign package and route the invoice.

Thanks — Ari

Hi Ari — thanks for the note and the addendum. Quick answers up front:

- Fireside format: acceptable but only if we retain the ability to show a 5-minute product demo within the 15-minute segment (i.e., 7–8 minute moderated discussion, 5-minute demo, 2–3 minute audience Q&A). We prefer a single moderator from the program team and one Redwood speaker.

- Banner & pre-roll: acceptable with size constraints. We need the roller-banner to be no larger than 4'x6' and pre-roll slide to include only logo + booth number (no CTA or promotional offer). Also request a second pre-roll rotation on the expo floor screens the day before the session.

I have cc'd Marissa and Vanessa to confirm logistics (stand size, install times, AV feed for demo). If Lily can update the addendum with the demo clause and size limits, we can sign this week.

Evelyn
